text_block_list.text: (Crackle... zap—)

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Father
text_block_list.text:
It's dangerous here, so get away!
Come on! Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (—This is a scene I recall from time to time.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(The local junior club I went to as a kid.
That familiar, beloved place—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(The flames climbed higher, swallowing everything up.
We fled in confusion, completely powerless...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Fortunately, none of the kids were seriously hurt.
Even so, to our young selves—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(It was a terror so overwhelming that even standing on the track
became next to impossible.)

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Daddy.
If I keep running without giving up...
do you think everyone will come back...?

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to see everyone again.
"

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text: "I want to run together with a smile. So... I'll keep running."

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text: Sadness, and loneliness too...

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text: If we can all hold hands, I'm sure we can make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, lovely weather.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah,
good morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Once again, starting today,
I look forward to working with you.

My challenge in the Twinkle Series
alongside Victoire Pisa has begun.

I've already scheduled a mock race for next weekend.
It's to help her get more accustomed
to actual race conditions.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
In this mock race, rather than chasing victory,
we should focus on checking your condition... right?
choice_data_list: Let's get you perfectly tuned up with your Make Debut in sight.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
One step at a time, right?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "—And that's the stretching done. I'll go ahead and do one run now."
And then one day, while out for a run off-campus to clear my head...

text_block_list.name: Bespannelled Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait up, I said~!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Those tracksuits—
could they be kids from the local junior club?
Two elementary school-aged Umamusume wearing matching jerseys dashed out of the stadium.

text_block_list.name: Bespannelled Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Don't say you're quitting...!
Why all of a sudden!?"

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Because...!
I'm just not cut out for racing!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Even though I tried super, super, super hard this time,
I didn't even make the board—this is ridiculous!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"I don't even want to race anymore!
So stop following me!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um.
—Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My name is Victoire Pisa,
and I am affiliated with Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would the two of you
come watch my race sometime?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I suppose that was a bit too abrupt after all. But I'm glad to see you're coming.
Though initially bewildered, the two of them were intrigued by the name "Tracen Academy" and agreed to come for a campus tour.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for inviting you on my own like this,
but I felt that I simply had to do it."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
For that sake... "The next mock race will be
a light check on condition."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if we put
that plan aside for the moment?
—I wasn't surprised by her suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hah, haa, haa...!
...With the power of races that weaves hearts together...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: With a decisive victory... I will protect their circle!

"Bring emotion to the stands."
"Connect people's hearts and bring true hope."
"For that is the guiding star of Victoire Pisa's life, and the flame that sets her heart ablaze."

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should just go home after all.
Tracen Academy makes me so nervous...

text_block_list.name: Bespannelled Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, wait! Since they went through the trouble of inviting us,
let's watch it properly before heading home!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's about to begin.
Turf 2000m—keep your eyes on Victoire Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has a calm demeanor you wouldn't expect from someone yet to debut.
She is definitely an Umamusume to keep an eye on for the main race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your support.
choice_data_list: With everything you've got — go seize victory! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And they're off!
A clean break for nearly the entire field.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa rounds the first corner
in fourth position from the rear—

text_block_list.name: Bespannelled Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...! Look at that running, it's incredible!
Such a beautiful stride――!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Around the fourth corner, under 400 meters to go!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Victoire Pisa takes the inside path! Bursting through from the innermost rail!!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
G... Go for it!
You can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Closing in fast is Eishin Flash!
Rose Kingdomâ

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Victoire Pisaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Kh!! Haaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Victoire Pisa crosses the wire with a complete victory!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text: W-Wah...!!

text_block_list.name: Bespannelled Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaah, amazing, amazing...! She really won!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, isn't she super strong!?
Like, seriously, wasn't that late surge insane!?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, that's a nice smile.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "After that, the two of us talked for hours about Pisa-san's running."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"My friend was having so much fun,
they completely forgot they ever wanted to quit racing."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"‘Racing is just so exciting after all, 
and I want to keep doing my best in training...
is what she excitedly told me.’"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I'll work much, much harder too.
Thank you so very much!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Thank goodness.
It seems you've made up with each other.

With a soft breath, the tension leaves my shoulders.
This mock race had a different kind of intensity
compared to a regular race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for your cooperation.
I feel relieved as well.
I had quite a... personal attachment to this one.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A friend who was here until yesterday
is now walking away from the track for good.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Because I believe I know that pain all too well.

And on the way home that day,
Victoire Pisa made a vow to me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I believe.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume racing creates inspiration and hope.
It even holds the power to connect people together.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "Could it be that... it might even be something capable of erasing 'loneliness' from this world—?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That it could even illuminate someone
shivering in solitude with a warm, gentle light.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why...
in the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Believing in this with all my heart—
I want to run through to the very end with every ounce of my strength.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best together.
Yeah, let's do our best together.

text_block_list.text:
A pure heart, always thinking of others to the utmost. Her extraordinary
purity was enough to bring an angel to mind.

What kind of path will she walk—?
And what kind of finish line awaits her—?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Together, let us connect them.
Piece by piece, one by one.

"It might lead to nothing"—
Even so, her legs surely will not stop.

Then I will watch over and support her by her side.
All the way to that far-off distance—her final destination.
choice_data_list: ...Believing that we will see the sky of hope.

text_block_list.text: And so, the Twinkle Series alongside Victoire Pisa had officially begun.
